about.title: About Me
about.intro: Computer Engineer, born in 1984 in Rimini and now based in Noventa di Piave, Veneto. Graduated in 2010, I work as an R&D and AI expert, designing and building complex distributed software systems.
about.expertise: My focus: .NET, Clean Architecture, Domain-Driven Design, Cloud, Mobile & Embedded, real-time distributed systems.
